svg.text: Board held with the sockets facing you and the USB-C port on the right, as BeagleBoard photographs it. On your table it is turned round; the numbers are the same.
P1.1 is 5 V. Nothing ever goes in here.
P1 close up. Column 1 is at the USB-C end. Outer row = odd pins, inner row = even pins.
3.3 V out. column 7, inner row, from the USB-C end.
ground. column 8, outer row, from the USB-C end.
SDA, data. column 13, inner row, from the USB-C end.
SCL, clock. column 14, inner row, from the USB-C end.
Trust the numbers printed on the board over
this picture. Find the printed 1 and 2 at the
USB-C end of P1 and the 35 and 36 at the far
end. If they are there, the columns are right.
